Battery Management System • Solar/Grid/Load Monitoring • Smart Switch Control
Capacity: per-unit ratedCapacity • Power: 10 kW rated • Operating Modes: TOU, Self Consumption, Backup
• Direct user to report to library maintainer
Special: Ambient Temp also requires ambient_temp is not None
Available when: coordinator.last_update_success AND charging_power_limited is not None
Mode selection works even when current_mode is None!
This allows users to change mode even when
current mode cannot be read from gateway.
• Centralized data fetching prevents multiple simultaneous API calls
• All entities share same data source (coordinator.data)
• Single 60-second update interval applies to all sensors
2. Mode Resolution via the Gateway, Not a Table
• runingMode values are per-account database ids, so no table can cover every account
• Resolve via getGatewayTouListV2 and read the profile's workMode (stable across accounts)
• Uses _switch_status() directly to avoid KeyError from library's get_mode()
• Mode fetch failure doesn't break sensor updates
• Unresolvable modes show as unknown; never guessed (issue #6)
• Mode selection works even when current mode cannot be determined
• Library async methods awaited directly (not via executor)
• Faster, more efficient, no coroutine object errors
• Critical data (stats) fails update if all retries exhausted
• Optional data (mode) set to None, doesn't block update
• Fewer "unavailable" states due to retry logic
• Mode selection always accessible (even when current mode unknown)
• Clear logging for troubleshooting and bug reports
